ITEM 1 | Torn pieces of pale green leafy lettuce with crisp, ruffled edges and pale yellow-white ribs, spread across most of a white paper plate about 26 cm wide, roughly 60% of the plate's diameter in footprint, mounded to about 2 cm high in the center; pieces roughly 4-8 cm long, moist with a creamy coating giving a slight sheen | 110

ITEM 2 | Creamy pale ivory dressing coating the leaves, visible as glossy, opaque smears between and over the lettuce pieces, thick enough to cling, with some pooling near the leaf bases; covers the same area as the greens | 35

ITEM 3 | Thin, flat, pale yellow-white shaved cheese shards, irregular and translucent-edged, about 3-4 cm long and 0.2 cm thick, lying on top of and among the lettuce near the center; dry, slightly waxy surface | 12

ITEM 4 | Small golden-tan toasted bread croutons, irregular cubes about 1-1.5 cm, browned at edges with slightly crisp, dry surfaces, scattered across the lettuce, mostly on the left and lower portions of the pile | 15

ITEM 5 | Small specks of green-tinged herb or chopped green pieces, bright green, finely scattered within the lettuce and dressing, about 2-5 mm, moist | 3
